items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: they decided that I did such a good job quote unquote that they left me on the recording, and that was when Al started hiring me.

ctx.x: We were talking about Al and his tunes.
Oh Al. Yep. And he would — once he got on stage he was a hundred percent, a hundred percent. And it was a great experience working with him.
Does it make you play better or differently?
